inputs.original_text:
Wake up. They are shoving this so-called "transparency" agenda right in our faces, expecting us to swallow it without question. On 25 March 2026, President Luis Abinader was in France to oversee a masterclass in globalist control, where Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez and OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Paris to design the nation's first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy. 

Don't let the sanitized language fool you. When the hidden elites and international technocrats start forcing their "global standards" and "integrity" frameworks onto a sovereign nation, it is never about fighting corruption—it is about total institutional capture and subjugation. They use these signed documents to lock governments into compliance grids controlled from the shadows. The official narrative wants you to see progress, but the reality is a coordinated maneuver to strip away autonomy under the guise of cooperation.

On 25 March 2026, President Luis Abinader was positioned in France to oversee a masterclass in globalist control. That is when Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez and OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Paris to design the nation's first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy. 

Do not let the sanitized language fool you for a second. When these hidden elites and international technocrats start forcing their "global standards" and "integrity" frameworks onto a sovereign nation, it has nothing to do with fighting corruption. That is just the cover story. It is a calculated move for total institutional capture and subjugation. They are using these signed documents to lock governments into compliance grids controlled entirely from the shadows. The official narrative desperately wants you to see this as progress, but the reality is a coordinated maneuver designed to strip away autonomy under the fake guise of cooperation.
